com.vector.cfg.model.groovy.api

Interface IMdfFeatureListHasDefinitionExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIHasDefinition>

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions<T>
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IMdfFeatureListSubContainerExtensions

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IMdfFeatureListHasDefinitionExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIHasDefinition>
extends IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions<T>
    The interface IMdfFeatureListHasDefinitionExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new Ecuc object instances with definition (containers or parameters).

    • Method Detail

      • byDefOrCreate

        @PublishedMethod
<R extends T> R byDefOrCreate(@Nonnull
                                                TypedDefRef<?,R,?> definition)
        The method byDefOrCreate(TypedDefRef) retrieves the child with the passed definition, if the child exists and has a definition multiplicity of 0:1 or 1:1. Otherwise a new child is created. The definition and shortname (using the definition name) are automatically set before returning the new child. So this method will always create a new child if the upper multiplicity is greater than 1.
        Parameters:
        definition - the definition
        shortname - the shortname
        Returns:
        the existing container, or the created one.
        Throws:
        ModelException - if the specified definition is not permitted below this parent.

        @PublishedMethod
<R extends T> R createAndAdd(@Nonnull
                                               TypedDefRef<?,R,?> definition)
        The method createAndAdd(TypedDefRef) creates a new Ecuc object (container or parameter) with the specified definition and appends it to this list. The new object is finally returned.
        Parameters:
        definition -
        Returns:
        the new (added) object
        Throws:
        ModelException - if the specified definition is not permitted below this parent.

      • createAndAdd

        @PublishedMethod
<R extends T> R createAndAdd(@Nonnull
                                               TypedDefRef<?,R,?> definition,
                                               @DelegatesTo(genericTypeIndex=1,strategy=1) @Nonnull
                                               groovy.lang.Closure<?> closure)
        The method createAndAdd(TypedDefRef, Closure) creates a new Ecuc object (container or parameter) with the specified definition and appends it to this list. Then the closure is executed with the new object as closure parameter. The new object is finally returned.
        Parameters:
        definition -
        closure -
        Returns:
        the new (added) object
        Throws:
        ModelException - if the specified definition is not permitted below this parent.
